hook: Where your first $1,000/month should go (in order).
direction: Priority stack: 1) a website that converts, 2) your email list, 3) Google Business Profile / local visibility, 4) paid ads last. Counterintuitive ordering earns saves. Numbered-list graphic.

facebook.text:
Where your first $1,000/month should go (in order).

1. A website that actually converts visitors into contacts or customers.
2. Your email list — you own it, no algorithm can take it away.
3. Google Business Profile and local visibility — free to claim, costly to ignore.
4. Paid ads — last, not first.

Most people start at the bottom of that list and wonder why nothing sticks. Build the foundation before you buy the traffic. The order matters more than the amount.
